title: Finite coefficient and site extension on bounded flat input models
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (one admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings), let $\ell$ be a prime, and let $A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$. Use ordinary constant-ring module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Let $a\le b$ be integers and let $L\in D^b(X_{\rm et},A)$ have constructible cohomology and Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$, meaning that $L\otimes^L_A H[0]$ has cohomology only in $[a,b]$ for every etale module sheaf $H$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] [def-kun-tor-amplitude]. Write $N_X=\nu_X^*$ for exact site comparison and $L_B=L\otimes^L_A B$ [lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact] [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor].
There is a flat constructible complex $P$, zero outside $[a,b]$, representing $L$. It is K-flat (tensoring it with any acyclic complex is acyclic). The complexes $P\otimes_A B$, $N_XP$, and $(N_XP)\otimes_A B$ are K-flat with flat terms and vanish outside $[a,b]$; they represent respectively $L_B$, $N_XL$, and $(N_XL)_B$. The canonical tensor comparison identifies the last complex with $N_X(P\otimes_A B)$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Both $L_B$ and $N_XL$ are bounded constructible of Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ on their respective sites, as is $(N_XL)_B$ [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. No flatness or finite projective dimension of $B$ over $A$ is required. Flatness and K-flatness use [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules] [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Schemes and Noetherian rings use [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring].
